in_hebrew.name: שְׁמוּאֵל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שְׁמוּאֵל, שְׁמוּעֵל, שְׁמֹעֵל, שְׁמוֹעֵל, שְׁמֻעַל, שְׁמֻעָל, שְׁמֻעֵל, שְׁמֹעַל - name meaning 'heard of God' or 'God has heard', from root שְׁמוּעַ, with Hebrew prefix שְׁ, indicating 'God has', related to Hebrew verb שָׁמַע, meaning 'to hear', in biblical context, Samuel is the eleventh and last major judge of the Bible, and a key figure in the transition from the period of the judges to the period of the monarchy, in Jewish tradition, Samuel is considered one of the greatest prophets of the Bible, with a spiritual significance of listening to God's voice and obeying His commands, in Christian tradition, Samuel is revered as a saint and a prophet, with a historical significance in the early Christian church as a model of obedience and faithfulness

in_greek.name: Σαμουήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Σαμουήλ, Σαμουήλ, Σαμωνή, Σαμωνήλ - name meaning 'heard of God' or 'God has heard', from Greek root σαμουήλ, with Greek prefix σαμ-, indicating 'heard of', related to Greek verb σαμαίνω, meaning 'to hear', in New Testament context, the name Samuel is mentioned in the Book of Acts, where the prophet Samuel is revered as a saint, with a spiritual significance of listening to God's voice and obeying His commands, in Christian tradition, Samuel is considered one of the greatest prophets of the Bible, with a historical significance in the early Christian church as a model of obedience and faithfulness

in_latin.name: Samuelis
in_latin.meaning: name meaning 'heard of God' or 'God has heard'
in_latin.long_meaning: Samuelis, name derived from Hebrew roots, with Latin form 'Samuelis', meaning 'heard of God' or 'God has heard', from Latin prefix 'Samu-', indicating 'heard of', related to Latin verb 'audire', meaning 'to hear', in early Christian church, the name Samuel was used to signify obedience and faithfulness, with a historical significance in Christian tradition as a model of devotion to God, in Latin context, the name Samuelis was often used to signify a person who had heard and obeyed God's voice
